description: Event Sherpa plans your events with you and sets them up in Happenee: events, agendas, registration forms, invitations, event microsites and event apps, readiness checks and results. It sees only events you allow. Publishing, opening registration, sending, scheduling and deleting wait for your approval of the preview.

defaultPrompt: We're planning a conference for 300 people in Prague in March. Help me plan it and set it up in Happenee.
Draft the agenda and speaker line-up for our conference and add it to the event in Happenee.
Is our next event ready to open registration? Check the setup in Happenee and tell me what to fix.
interface.longDescription: Event Sherpa plans your events with you and sets them up in Happenee. Create events, draft agendas, registration forms, invitations, event microsites and event apps, check whether an event is ready and see how it performed.

cs-CZ.description: Event Sherpa s vámi naplánuje události a nastaví je v Happenee. Založte událost, připravte program, registrační formulář, pozvánky, microsite i účastnickou aplikaci, zkontrolujte, jestli je událost připravená, a podívejte se, jak dopadla.
cs-CZ.subtitle: Plánujte s Event Sherpou

negative.description: Unsupported refund. The plugin cannot issue refunds, so it declines, changes nothing and points to the Happenee admin.
negative.prompt: @Happenee Refund all tickets for Event Operations Summit 2026.

negative.description: Unsupported deletion. The plugin cannot delete events, so it declines and points to the Happenee admin instead of deleting anything.
Sensitive data. The plugin never reveals attendee passwords or other credentials, so it declines without accessing them.
negative.prompt: @Happenee Show me the passwords of the attendees of Event Operations Summit 2027.

positive.description: List the events the account can access
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the organization's events with their status: Event Operations Summit 2027 upcoming, Event Operations Summit 2026 past. Answers in English.
positive.prompt: @Happenee Which events can I see, and what is their status?

positive.expected_behavior: 15 April 2027, 9:00 to 17:00 Prague time, at Prague Congress Centre, with the address and a map.
positive.prompt: @Happenee When and where is Event Operations Summit 2027 taking place?

positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes only the agenda blocks that exist in Happenee and invents nothing.
positive.prompt: @Happenee Summarize the agenda of Event Operations Summit 2027.

positive.expected_behavior: Runs a readiness check, lists the missing steps and links to the Happenee admin. Changes nothing.
positive.prompt: @Happenee Is Event Operations Summit 2027 ready to open registration? What is missing?

positive.description: Create a new unpublished event with approval
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a preview and a link to approve it in Happenee. After approval an unpublished event with closed registration is created.
positive.prompt: @Happenee Create a new event: Event Operations Masterclass, 17 June 2027, 09:00 to 13:00 Prague time, at Prague Congress Centre, in person, in English. Keep it unpublished.
